retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for 1960s-style pop album covers featuring studio portraits of smiling performers against solid backgrounds with heavy swash typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1960s studio portrait composition featuring a central male figure in a dark suit flanked by female figures in bright orange, set against a textured blue backdrop with prominent, decorative swash typography in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in dark suit as the primary visual anchor
Supporting figures in high-contrast orange clothing
Text clustered in the upper left quadrant
Solid blue background providing a clean field for subjects and type
coreInvariants: High-key studio lighting with soft shadows
Complementary blue and orange color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is mid-ground right, secondary subjects are staggered in the background and foreground left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The male figure in the dark suit provides the heaviest visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large white title in the top left, down the list of tracks, then across to the smiling faces of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue background acts as negative space, primarily concentrated in the upper right and around the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange clothing on female subjects
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange and blue, with high value contrast between the dark suit and the bright background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with extreme swashes
letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated, curly swashes on capital letters
Italicized or slanted orientation for secondary headers
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'C' and 'M' feature deep, circular curls
Lowercase 'z' has a decorative descending tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold white swash display paired with smaller yellow script-like serif for secondary info.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy weight and decorative curls of the era.
Provides the necessary weight and friendly retro feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a black suit and three women in bright orange sweaters, all smiling, against a textured blue wall background. Leave the top-left quadrant clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, white, decorative swash font in the top left. Below it, add secondary text in a smaller, yellow, italicized serif font.

verificationChecks: Are the swashes on the display text prominent?
Is the blue/orange color contrast maintained?
Is the lighting consistent with 1960s studio photography?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure faces
Check for proper left-alignment of text blocks
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Studio Portrait with 60s Styling] + [Textured Blue Backdrop] + [Left-Aligned Swash Typography in White/Yellow].
